Node2D.doc: Empty 2D transform. Use to group and move children together.

position.doc: Pixels, relative to parent. +y is down.

z_index.doc: Draw order; higher draws on top.

Sprite2D.doc: Draws an image. Without a texture draws a solid rect of `size` in `modulate`.

position.doc: Pixels, relative to parent. +y is down.

z_index.doc: Draw order; higher draws on top.

size.doc: Displayed size in pixels (texture is scaled to fit).

anims.doc: Animation set, "data/anims/<name>.json" (frame lists). Play with e:play("run").

anim.doc: Animation playing (set to start one at spawn; e:play() changes it).

auto_flip.doc: Face the direction of horizontal movement (sets flip_h from the velocity of this sprite or its Body2D parent). Art should face right.

color.doc: Alias of `modulate` (handy for untextured solid rects); setting it sets modulate.

emissive.doc: Drawn above Lighting2D darkness at full brightness (glowing eyes, lamps, UI-like world text).

blend.doc: "add" = additive (glows, fire, light beams, fake night lights): brightens what is behind.

Body2D.doc: Physics body. Put Sprite2D children on it for visuals.

position.doc: Pixels, relative to parent. +y is down.

z_index.doc: Draw order; higher draws on top.

body.doc: static = walls/floors, dynamic = simulated, kinematic = moved by script.

size.doc: rect: w,h. circle: x = diameter. capsule: w,h.

lock_rotation.doc: Prevent physics from rotating the body.

layer.doc: Collision layer name from dreamsy.toml [physics] layers (e.g. "player"). "" = on every layer.

mask.doc: Comma-separated layers this collides with / detects (e.g. "world,enemy"). "" = every layer.

Area2D.doc: Trigger zone: reports overlaps, no collision response.

smoothing.doc: Follow smoothing: 0 = locked to the target, 0.5 = soft, 0.9 = very floaty.

deadzone.doc: Box (world px, w,h) around the view center the target can move in without the camera moving.

limit_min.doc: World top-left corner the view may not go past (unset = no limit).

limit_max.doc: World bottom-right corner the view may not go past (unset = no limit).

position.doc: Pixels, relative to parent. +y is down.

z_index.doc: Draw order; higher draws on top.

align.doc: Horizontal anchor: center = text centered on position, left = text starts at position, right = text ends at position. Vertically centered on position.

font.doc: Font family; "default" = the game's [ui] font (from the style preset).

outline_size.doc: Outline thickness in pixels (0 = none). 2-4 makes text readable on busy backgrounds.

emissive.doc: Drawn above Lighting2D darkness at full brightness (glowing eyes, lamps, UI-like world text).

TileMap2D.doc: A grid of tiles (a level) drawn and collided as one entity. `position` is the top-left corner of tile (0,0).

position.doc: Pixels, relative to parent. +y is down.

z_index.doc: Draw order; higher draws on top.

tile_size.doc: Tile width and height in pixels.

data.doc: The grid: rows of tile characters joined by "\n" (top row first), or "file:data/levels/<name>.txt".

layer.doc: Collision layer name from dreamsy.toml [physics] layers (e.g. "player"). "" = on every layer.

mask.doc: Comma-separated layers this collides with / detects (e.g. "world,enemy"). "" = every layer.

Particles2D.doc: Particle emitter (dust, sparks, explosions, trails). Emits `rate`/s while `emitting`; e:burst(n) emits n at once. Particles move in world space.

position.doc: Pixels, relative to parent. +y is down.

z_index.doc: Draw order; higher draws on top.

lifetime_random.doc: 0..1: random fraction shaved off each lifetime.

direction.doc: Emit direction in degrees (0 = right, -90 = up, 90 = down).

spread.doc: Cone width in degrees around `direction` (360 = all around).

speed_random.doc: 0..1: random fraction of speed removed per particle.

shape.doc: Shape when there is no texture.

texture.doc: Optional particle image (tinted by the color).

emission_size.doc: Spawn area (w,h px) around the emitter; [0,0] = a point.

emissive.doc: Drawn above Lighting2D darkness at full brightness (glowing eyes, lamps, UI-like world text).

blend.doc: "add" = additive (glows, fire, light beams, fake night lights): brightens what is behind.

Light2D.doc: Point light for dark scenes (needs a Lighting2D in the scene). Child of the player = a torch that follows. Up to 64 lit at once (nearest to the view).

position.doc: Pixels, relative to parent. +y is down.

z_index.doc: Draw order; higher draws on top.

radius.doc: Reach in pixels (light is 0 at the edge).

energy.doc: Brightness multiplier (0 = off; >1 burns out to full brightness sooner).

falloff.doc: Edge softness: 1 = linear, 2 = soft (default), 4 = tight bright core.

enabled.doc: Lit when true (tween `energy` to fade instead of popping).

Lighting2D.doc: Scene darkness: everything (except `emissive` things and UI) is darkened toward `ambient`; Light2Ds cut holes. One per scene.

ambient.doc: Color of unlit areas (deep blue night, black cave, red alarm).

darkness.doc: 0 = no darkening, 1 = unlit areas are exactly `ambient`.

UIButton.doc: Screen-space button; scripts listen for presses.

anchor.doc: Screen anchor (top-level UI stays inside the phone safe area: notch, home bar).

scale.doc: Visual scale around the center (tween it to pop/bounce UI; layout size is unchanged).

font.doc: Font family; "default" = the game's [ui] font (from the style preset).

icon.doc: Optional icon image shown with the label.

icon_size.doc: Icon size in pixels (0 = 70% of the button height, or 45% with icon_position top).

icon_position.doc: Icon left of the label, or above it.

UIPanel.doc: Screen-space rectangle; parent for other UI.

anchor.doc: Screen anchor (top-level UI stays inside the phone safe area: notch, home bar).

scale.doc: Visual scale around the center (tween it to pop/bounce UI; layout size is unchanged).

input_transparent.doc: Taps pass through the panel itself (its buttons still work) — for HUD frames over the play area.

scroll.doc: Vertical scrolling list: clips children; drag/flick on touch, mouse wheel on desktop. Content height = lowest child (use layout = "stack" to stack children automatically).

layout.doc: stack = children placed top to bottom in order (their offset.y adds extra space, anchor picks left/center/right); none = each child uses its own anchor + offset.

padding.doc: Inset of stacked children from the panel's top (layout = stack).

radius.doc: Corner radius in pixels (-1 = from the [ui] panel style).

clip.doc: Clip children to the panel (scroll panels always clip).

pixel.label: Pixel art
pixel.build: Retro pixel art. Design on a 16px (or 32px) grid; positions and sizes are multiples of it. Small limited palette (≤16 colors, use style.palette if set). Sprites are tiny and readable; animate with few frames. Base resolution is low and upscaled.
pixel.assetPrompt: pixel art, crisp hard pixel edges, no anti-aliasing, no blur, limited color palette, transparent background, single centered subject, orthographic side or 3/4 view, game sprite

blocky.label: Blocky
blocky.build: Chunky block/voxel look. Build the world and most props from primitives (box, cylinder, sphere) with flat colors; compose characters from boxes. Use generated meshes only for hero objects. Bright saturated palette, 1-unit grid.
blocky.assetPrompt: blocky voxel style, chunky cube shapes, flat saturated colors, simple, low detail, toy-like, plain background, single centered subject

clean.label: Clean
clean.build: Minimal flat-vector look. Simple geometric shapes, generous whitespace, soft palette of 3–5 colors, no texture noise. Readability over detail. In 3D: smooth low-poly with solid materials.
clean.assetPrompt: clean flat vector illustration, simple geometric shapes, smooth edges, soft limited palette, minimal detail, no texture, no outlines, plain background, single centered subject

toon.label: Toon
toon.build: Cel-shaded cartoon. Exaggerated proportions, bold silhouettes, dark outlines, 2–3 tone shading. Generated meshes for characters and key props; primitives for terrain blocks.
toon.assetPrompt: cartoon style, cel shading, bold dark outlines, exaggerated proportions, vibrant colors, plain background, single centered subject

custom.label: Custom
custom.build: Follow style.notes and the reference images exactly; keep every asset consistent with them.
